name: gk-engineering
description: Scope-sized product delivery with audited current-model fallbacks for unavailable Sol, Terra, or Luna routes, Ego Lite browser evidence, persistent Program progress, raw runtime provenance, evidence lifecycle, completion telemetry, and auditable Goal retrospectives.

interface.shortDescription: Audited role-model fallbacks with Ego Lite acceptance.
interface.longDescription: Sizes approved work before planning, falls back to the current model when a preferred Sol, Terra, or Luna route is unavailable, keeps one Program Goal across child milestones, treats native spawn arguments and actual per-turn models as authoritative, records runtime provenance and evidence invalidation, runs all browser journeys through Ego Lite, preserves independent final acceptance plus a completion-telemetry-backed raw-evidence gate, and produces an auditable post-completion Goal retrospective.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $product-to-delivery to guide this feature from discovery through approved and verified delivery.
